title: Survey response submitted
description: One respondent completed a survey, so a Tenant's own system can react — score a quiz, open a ticket, credit an account. The event deliberately carries no answers: they are personal data of the Tenant's customers and are read from the API with `survey:response:read` instead. Survey appends the event to its transactional outbox in the same transaction as the response it reports. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

version_id.description: The immutable version the respondent answered. A later version never changes the meaning of this event.

response_id.description: The completed response. Fetch it with `GET /responses/{id}` for the answers.

link_id.description: The link the respondent came through. Null only for a response recorded before this event existed to carry it.

source.description: The Tenant-named source of the link, for example `qr-store-01` or `email-november`. The same string the survey's funnel groups by.

external_ref.description: The personal link's own reference, which is how a Tenant matches a response to a customer in its own system. Null for a public link.

respondent_identity.description: The personal link's `external_ref`, else the answer to the question the version marks as identity, lower-cased and trimmed. Null when the survey asks for neither.

score.description: The recomputed quiz score, or null when the version does not enable scoring. The server ignores any score a client sends.

submitted_at.description: When the server recorded the completion, in UTC.
